We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As a Senior Growth Lead, you will own candidate pipeline performance end-to-end for some of Mercor’s most important initiatives. You’ll operate with significantly autonomy and lead a pod of Associates, making judgment calls on prioritization, channel strategy, and execution.

This role is ideal for someone who has mastered the fundamentals of sales and outbound work and is ready to drive outcomes. You will still be hands-on, but you’ll also shape strategy, improve systems, and help raise the bar for the broader team.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own Expert Sourcing Pods: Lead expert sourcing for a defined set of projects, owning outcomes across quality, speed, and throughput

  • Manage Capacity & Throughput: Plan and balance your own workload and the capacity of Growth Associates to consistently meet demand

  • Scale & Optimize Sourcing Channels: Evaluate, experiment with, and scale sourcing channels to maximize yield and efficiency

  • Build & Maintain Expert Relationships: Develop durable relationships with high-performing experts to drive repeat engagement

  • Oversee Talent Pipelines: Manage multiple pipelines end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks and proactively reallocating resources

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Project Managers, Product, and Engineering to align sourcing strategy with project needs

  • Drive Growth Outcomes: Ensure your pod’s sourcing efforts directly support revenue growth and delivery at scale

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience

    • 3–5 years of experience in GTM, outbound sales, or growth roles

    • Demonstrated success owning pipelines and delivering results at scale

    • Strong familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, and similar tools

  • Skills & Mindset

    • Strong judgment and ability to prioritize under pressure

    • Highly data-driven: comfortable tracking, analyzing, and optimizing funnel metrics

    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

    • Self-directed, accountable, and comfortable operating with ambiguity

    • Thrives in fast-paced, performance-oriented environments

  • Nice to Have

    • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior teammates

    • Exposure to marketplaces, platforms, or two-sided businesses

    • Comfort working cross-functionally with technical teams

 

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

We're looking for an Early Career & University Recruiter to build Mercor's university recruiting, early-career hiring, and internship programs from the ground up.

You'll own the strategy for how we identify, attract, and hire exceptional emerging talent across engineering, machine learning, and business functions. From developing university partnerships to creating new ways of finding talent beyond traditional recruiting channels, you'll help build the next generation of Mercor.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can think strategically, execute independently, and build programs that scale.

What You'll Do

  • Build our early-career recruiting strategy: Develop and execute Mercor's approach to university recruiting, new-grad hiring, and internships, including target talent pools, recruiting calendars, and hiring plans.

  • Find exceptional emerging talent: Identify and engage high-potential students and early-career professionals through creative sourcing strategies that go beyond traditional campus recruiting and established university pipelines.

  • Own full-cycle recruiting: Drive sourcing, assessment, candidate engagement, and closing for intern and new-grad roles across engineering, ML, and business functions.

  • Build and scale our internship program: Establish the recruiting framework, selection process, and return-offer strategy, partnering with hiring managers and People to create a strong intern experience.

  • Create new talent pipelines: Develop initiatives such as hackathons, fellowships, student partnerships, and ambassador programs where they can meaningfully improve our ability to attract exceptional talent.

  • Partner with leadership: Work closely with hiring managers and functional leaders to define early-career talent needs, establish hiring standards, and align recruiting plans with business priorities.

  • Measure and improve outcomes: Establish the metrics and operating processes needed to evaluate program effectiveness, candidate quality, offer acceptance, and intern-to-full-time conversion.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of recruiting experience, including meaningful ownership of university, early-career, or internship recruiting.

  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly transforming an early-career recruiting program, with clear ownership and measurable results.

  • Strong technical recruiting experience, particularly with engineering, computer science, or machine learning talent.

  • Exceptional sourcing creativity and the ability to identify high-potential candidates beyond traditional credentials, universities, and employer brands.

  • Ability to develop a strategy and independently translate it into execution without relying on established infrastructure.

  • Strong stakeholder management, including the ability to influence hiring managers, challenge assumptions, and drive accountability.

  • A data-driven approach to measuring recruiting effectiveness, improving processes, and making prioritization decisions.

  • Willingness to travel for university partnerships, recruiting events, and other high-impact opportunities.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building early-career or university recruiting programs in a high-growth startup environment.

  • Experience developing nontraditional talent pipelines, technical student communities, hackathons, or fellowship programs.

  • Experience designing internship recruiting programs that have delivered strong intern-to-full-time conversion.

Ideal Qualities

  • Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

  • Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

  • Growth Mindset - You don’t need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

  • Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

  • Love for the Craft - we are building a zero to one motion; this hire will bring a low ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition organization

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the role

Mercor provides the data and evaluations that help AI models improve. As a primary data partner to the world’s leading AI labs, we’ve built systems to evaluate and train their models. We now bring that same expertise to enterprises, helping them test AI on real business tasks and improve performance through custom evaluations, expert data, and post-training. Our network of more than 8 million domain experts allows us to deliver this at scale.

We’re hiring a Partnerships Lead to build Mercor’s consulting and SI partner business from the ground up. You’ll develop relationships with leading firms, create programs that bring Mercor into their client engagements, and drive revenue through those partnerships.

We’re launching two programs:

  • Joint go-to-market fund: Mercor provides funding to help partners win and deliver client engagements, with each company contracting directly with the client.

  • Referral program: Partners earn fees for introducing new business to Mercor.

You’ll own both programs, from recruiting partners and structuring deals to building pipeline and closing business.

What you'll do

  • Build relationships with leading consulting firms, systems integrators, and enterprise AI companies.

  • Work with partners to identify opportunities, pitch joint solutions, and win client engagements.

  • Own the joint go-to-market fund and referral program, including partner recruitment, deal registration, approvals, and performance tracking.

  • Work with finance and legal to structure partner incentives, payments, and commercial agreements.

  • Develop the sales materials, training, and tools partners need to sell Mercor’s services.

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline, revenue targets, and forecasting. Prioritize partnerships based on revenue potential and results.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in partnerships, alliances, or business development, ideally with experience building a partner business from scratch.

  • Track record of generating revenue through consulting or SI partnerships, including co-selling, partner funding, or referral programs.

  • Strong relationships at major consulting firms (MBB, Big Four, Accenture) and an understanding of their business models and commercial incentives.

  • Experience negotiating commercial agreements and structuring partner incentives with finance and legal.

  • Experience selling services through partners, not just software.

Nice to have

  • Experience building partnerships at an AI or data company, or within a consulting firm’s technology partnerships team.

  • Experience with cloud co-sell or marketplace programs (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, or model training.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager, Code
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As an Engagement Manager on the Code team, you will sell and deliver enterprise evaluations and post-training data for coding models and agents. Your customers are frontier AI labs, AI coding tool companies, and enterprise software organizations that need to measure and improve how their models perform on real-world engineering work.

You'll be the technical and commercial owner of each account: running discovery with ML researchers and engineering leaders, scoping custom evaluation and data programs, and working with Mercor's product, operations, and engineering teams to deliver them. This role carries a revenue target and plays a key part in growing Mercor's code business.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of AI labs, coding tool companies, and enterprise engineering teams, and run the full sales cycle from first technical conversation through signed contract and expansion

  • Run technical discovery to understand where a customer's models fall short on real software tasks, and turn that into a clear proposal

  • Scope and price enterprise evaluation and post-training data programs, such as coding benchmarks, SFT and RLHF datasets, and agentic coding tasks across languages, frameworks, and codebases

  • Lead technical demos and pilots, and convert pilot results into multi-quarter commitments

  • Work with product, operations, and engineering to recruit software engineering experts and deliver on quality and timelines

  • Forecast pipeline and revenue, and bring customer feedback back to Mercor's product and research teams

Ideally You'd Have

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field

  • 4+ years as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, solutions architect, or technical account executive at an enterprise B2B software company

  • A track record of closing and expanding six- and seven-figure enterprise deals with technical buyers

  • Hands-on coding ability: you can read a pull request, write a script, and discuss how a model fails on real code

  • Familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated (SFT, RLHF, coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench), or a strong drive to learn it quickly

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both researchers and executives

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary w/ aggressive bi-annual performance bonus structure + meaningful equity (aligned with a venture-backed, rapidly scaling AI company)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry/housekeeping reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As an Legal Engagement Manager, you will help legal tech companies, application-layer AI companies, and law firms post-train and evaluate models for legal work. You'll serve as their primary point of contact from first conversation through delivery.

Your legal training is central to the role. You'll help customers define what high-quality legal work looks like, turn it into evaluations and training data, and work with Mercor's network of lawyers to produce it. You'll also lead commercial processes for new and existing customers and help leadership find and unblock growth in the legal market.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of legal tech companies, application-layer companies, and law firms, from first meeting through delivery and expansion

  • Lead commercial processes for new and existing business, including scoping, pricing, and contracting

  • Work with customer, product, and research teams to design evaluations and post-training data for legal tasks such as contract review, legal research, drafting, and litigation support

  • Translate legal practice into rubrics and task specifications that models can be trained and measured against

  • Help recruit and calibrate lawyer experts on Mercor's platform, and work with operations to track quality and timelines

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer questions, issues, and escalations, and drive them to resolution

  • Forecast revenue and surface opportunities for account growth

Ideally You'd Have

  • JD required; bar admission and experience practicing at a law firm or in-house strongly preferred

  • 4+ years of total work experience, which may include legal practice, legal tech, or consulting for legal clients

  • A track record in client-facing roles and in building and expanding relationships

  • Strong interest in how AI is changing legal work; familiarity with LLMs, model evaluation, or legal tech products is a plus

  • Comfort working with ML and engineering stakeholders

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the precision expected of a practicing lawyer

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary w/ aggressive bi-annual performance bonus structure + meaningful equity (aligned with a venture-backed, rapidly scaling AI company)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry/housekeeping reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the role

Mercor provides the data and evaluations that help AI models improve. As a primary data partner to the world’s leading AI labs, we’ve built systems to evaluate and train their models. We now bring that same expertise to enterprises, helping them test AI on real business tasks and improve performance through custom evaluations, expert data, and post-training. Our network of more than 8 million domain experts allows us to deliver this at scale.

We’re hiring a Partnerships Lead to build Mercor’s business across the AI infrastructure ecosystem, including inference providers, GPU clouds, open-source model companies, and reinforcement learning platforms.

You’ll build partnerships that bring Mercor into customers’ post-training and model customization projects. This is a new function, and you’ll be responsible for developing the partner strategy, establishing referral and co-sell programs, and generating revenue through these relationships.

What you'll do

  • Build relationships with inference providers, GPU clouds, open-source model companies, and reinforcement learning platforms.

  • Develop referral and co-sell programs that generate new business for Mercor.

  • Work with inference providers to include Mercor’s services in their startup programs, including joint credits and other incentives.

  • Manage partnerships with companies that are also Mercor customers, coordinating with our engagement teams.

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline, revenue targets, and forecasting.

  • Identify new partnership opportunities and negotiate commercial agreements.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in partnerships, business development, or sales at an AI infrastructure, inference, or compute company.

  • Strong understanding of post-training, evaluations, and reinforcement learning, with the ability to work directly with ML engineers and technical product teams.

  • Experience developing referral or co-sell programs with technical partners.

  • Established relationships with companies across the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

  • Experience building new partnerships and generating revenue, not just managing existing accounts.

Nice to have

  • Partnerships experience at an inference provider (Baseten, Fireworks, Together AI) or on a GPU company’s ecosystem team.

  • Experience building platform partnerships at a developer-focused company.

  • Experience managing startup partnership or credits programs.
